summary: July PCE came in hotter than expected, with headline inflation at 3.7% year-over-year, cementing the Fed's hawkish hold and setting up markets waiting for Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech today for clues on how he intends to navigate the tension between softer growth and persistent price pressures.
tweet: Hot PCE locked in the Fed's hawkish hold and Warsh's Jackson Hole debut today is the only thing standing between markets and a rate-hike reprice — Nvidia's beat bought stocks a night of relief.
